findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_webpage, batch_fetch_webpages, map_website, search_web, search_leads, search_x_posts · Private data: fetch_webpage, webpage_to_markdown, extract_webpage_text, inspect_webpage, batch_fetch_webpages · Public sink: render_webpage, inspect_webpage · Destructive: fetch_webpage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_webpage, batch_fetch_webpages, map_website, search_web, search_leads, search_x_posts · Private data: fetch_webpage, webpage_to_markdown, extract_webpage_text, inspect_webpage, batch_fetch_webpages · Public sink: render_webpage, inspect_webpage · Destructive: fetch_webpage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
